_meta.indication: CYTALUX is an optical imaging agent indicated in adult patients with ovarian cancer as an adjunct for intraoperative identification of malignant lesions.

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, single-arm, single dose, open-label, multicenter study in which patients received both normal light imaging evaluation and fluorescence imaging evaluation (within-patient comparison).
pivotal_trials.population: Women diagnosed with ovarian cancer or with high clinical suspicion of ovarian cancer scheduled to undergo primary surgical cytoreduction, interval debulking, or recurrent ovarian cancer surgery.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of patients with at least one evaluable ovarian cancer lesion confirmed by central pathology detected with CYTALUX under fluorescent light but not under normal light or palpation and not otherwise identified for resection prior to surgery (prespecified success threshold 10%).
pivotal_trials.n: 178 enrolled; 150 received CYTALUX; 134 in the Intent-to-Image (primary efficacy) set.
pivotal_trials.result: Primary endpoint met: 36 of 134 patients (26.9%, 95% CI 19.6, 35.2; p<0.001) had at least one confirmed lesion detected only with CYTALUX, exceeding the 10% success threshold.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence >=1%) were nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, flushing, dyspepsia, chest discomfort, pruritus and hypersensitivity. In clinical studies 2.4% of patients experienced infusion reactions during the period of administration, which typically occurred within 15 minutes of the start of infusion.
target_moa: Pafolacianine is a fluorescent drug that targets folate receptor (FR), which may be overexpressed in ovarian cancer; it binds FR-expressing cancer cells, internalizes via receptor-mediated endocytosis, and concentrates in FR-positive tissues, emitting near-infrared fluorescence.
modality: Small molecule (folate analog conjugated to a near-infrared cyanine dye; optical imaging agent).

rems.type: No additional risk evaluation and management strategies were required beyond those recommended in the labeling.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting or other external consultation was deemed necessary for this NDA.
